neighbours.label: The closing noun of a negated claim about what something can do (can't solve the funding gap, won't remove the wrinkles); the same claim without negation stays low
fire: This new budget can't close the staffing gap.
Their vitamin pills won't reverse the hair loss.
A short course can't replace the missing experience.
Stronger locks won't stop the rising crime.
That extra bus can't reduce the morning crowding.
This cheap paint won't hide the deeper cracks.
One small grant can't fix the housing crisis.
Better signs won't solve the parking problem.
